# UTAS ePrints

> University of Tasmania's institutional research repository providing open access to scholarly works, theses, and special collections through an EPrints-based digital platform.

UTAS ePrints is a comprehensive digital repository that preserves and provides discovery access to the University of Tasmania's research outputs, academic publications, and archival materials. The repository integrates with major academic indexing services and supports open access principles through its institutional archive infrastructure.

## Core Repository Functions

- [Home - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au): University of Tasmania's digital research repository homepage
- [About the Repository - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/information.html): About page detailing UTAS ePrints repository history and mission
- [Latest 20 Additions to ePrints - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/cgi/latest_tool): Recent scholarly works and research additions to repository

## Browse and Discover

- [Browse by Year - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/view/year): Chronological browsing interface for research outputs by year
- [Browse by Author - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/view/authors/index.A.html): Alphabetical author directory for discovering academic publications
- [Browse by Collections - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/view/collections): Special collections and Tasmanian archives catalog browsing

## Analytics and Technical Information

- [Repository Statistics - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/cgi/stats/report): Analytics dashboard showing repository usage and download metrics
- [About EPrints - ePrints](https://eprints.utas.edu.au/eprints): Technical information about EPrints 3.3.16 software platform
